tools.name: check_skill_repo
tools.description: Static check of every SKILL.md (Claude Code / Codex agent skills) in a public GitHub repo: frontmatter and YAML errors, name/folder mismatch, missing or weak descriptions, slash-command-only wording that blocks automatic triggering, disable-model-invocation, nested SKILL.md, duplicate names, and pai

tools.name: preflight_skill
tools.description: Call BEFORE installing a skill or skill pack from GitHub. Pass the repo and the skills the user already has (name + description, e.g. from your own skill listing). Returns, for each new skill: static problems, name clashes that would shadow an installed skill, which installed skills it is most likel
